steps.en: Install the package and import its stylesheet
steps.zh: 安装这个包并导入它的样式表

steps.en: Create a tour with the darkened overlay switched on
steps.zh: 创建一个开启压暗遮罩的引导

steps.en: Add steps: which element to attach to, the text, and what advances it
steps.zh: 添加步骤：贴在哪个元素上、说什么、什么动作推进

steps.en: Waits for the target, scrolls to it, cuts an opening in the overlay and pins the step dialog
steps.zh: 等目标出现、滚过去、在遮罩上开口并钉上步骤对话框

steps.en: Advances on buttons, arrow keys or your page event, firing show/complete/cancel events
steps.zh: 随按钮、方向键或页面事件推进，发出 show/complete 等事件

value.en: One tour engine that behaves the same in React, Angular, Vue and plain pages
value.zh: 一个引导引擎，在 React、Angular、Vue 和纯页面里表现一致
